items.quote: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
items.claim: Abraham buried his wife Sarah in a cave at Machpelah before Mamre, identified as Hebron in Canaan.
items.place: cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre / Hebron in the land of Canaan
